description:
[Legacy] Get a report of your organization's Messages API usage, aggregated into time buckets.

This endpoint is part of the legacy Usage and Cost API. For new integrations, use [`GET /v1/organizations/analytics/usage`](/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/usage/list) in the Usage and Cost Analytics API instead. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Usage and Cost API](/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api#migrate-from-usage-cost-api).

parameters.description:
Maximum number of time buckets to return in the response.

The default and max limits depend on `bucket_width`:
• `"1d"`: Default of 7 days, maximum of 31 days
• `"1h"`: Default of 24 hours, maximum of 168 hours
• `"1m"`: Default of 60 minutes, maximum of 1440 minutes
parameters.name: limit

data.description: List of time buckets for this page, oldest first: one per `bucket_width` interval, including intervals with no usage (their `results` list is empty). A page holds at most `limit` buckets.
data.title: Data

has_more.description: Indicates if there are more results.
has_more.title: Has More

next_page.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or `null` when `has_more` is false. Pass it as the `page` parameter in the next request.
next_page.title: Next Page

ending_at.description: End of the time bucket (exclusive) in RFC 3339 format.
ending_at.title: Ending At

results.description: List of usage items for this time bucket.  There may be multiple items if one or more `group_by[]` parameters are specified.
results.title: Results

starting_at.description: Start of the time bucket (inclusive) in RFC 3339 format.
starting_at.title: Starting At

account_id.description: ID of the user account that made the request. `null` if not grouping by account or if no user account made the request.
account_id.title: Account Id

api_key_id.description: ID of the API key used. `null` if not grouping by API key or if the request did not use an API key, as with usage in the Claude Console or from most Claude Managed Agents sessions.
api_key_id.title: Api Key Id

cache_creation.description: The number of input tokens for cache creation.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens read from the cache.
cache_read_input_tokens.title: Cache Read Input Tokens

context_window.description: Context window used. `null` if not grouping by context window.

inference_geo.description:
Inference geo used matching requests' `inference_geo` parameter if set, otherwise the workspace's `default_inference_geo`.
For models that do not support specifying `inference_geo` the value is `"not_available"`. Always `null` if not grouping by inference geo.
inference_geo.title: Inference Geo

model.description: Model used. `null` if not grouping by model.
model.title: Model

output_tokens.description: The number of output tokens generated.
output_tokens.title: Output Tokens

service_account_id.description: ID of the service account that made the request. `null` if not grouping by service account or if no service account made the request. This can be the ID of an Anthropic-managed service account, such as one that runs Claude Managed Agents sessions, which the Service Accounts endpoints do not return.
service_account_id.title: Service Account Id

service_tier.description: Service tier used. `null` if not grouping by service tier.

speed.description: Speed of the usage. `null` if not grouping by speed.

uncached_input_tokens.description: The number of uncached input tokens processed.
uncached_input_tokens.title: Uncached Input Tokens

workspace_id.description: ID of the Workspace used. `null` if not grouping by workspace or for the default workspace.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

ephemeral_1h_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens used to create the 1 hour cache entry.
ephemeral_1h_input_tokens.title: Ephemeral 1H Input Tokens

ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.description: The number of input tokens used to create the 5 minute cache entry.
ephemeral_5m_input_tokens.title: Ephemeral 5M Input Tokens
